notes: Edition: CCF 7th edition, released 2026-03-31 (erratum fix 2026-04-09) after reviews in Jan 2026. Changes vs 2022: +14 journals, +23 conferences; 6 journal and 5 conference upgrades; 1 conference removed; 2 conferences and 1 journal downgraded; 2 renamed. Official PDF: https://www.ccf.org.cn/ccf/contentcore/resource/download?ID=112CF3BF7E1140ACEB271ADAED12A67ADFABB8FF099E40C2759502A85C8A281F

AI-relevant changes (diffed from the official PDFs): ICLR newly added as A; IJCAI A to B; IEEE TMM B to A; ACM THRI added as C; Interspeech C to B; WINE A to B; Bioinformatics B to A. Unchanged A: CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, AAAI, ACL, ACM MM, TPAMI, IJCV, AIJ, JMLR, TIP. Unchanged B: ECCV, EMNLP, NAACL, ICRA, AAMAS. IROS stays C.

Caution: as of 2026-10-19 the per-category pages on ccf.org.cn (e.g., /Academic_Evaluation/AI/) still show the 6th-edition table (IJCAI as A, no ICLR). Cite the official 7th-edition PDF linked from the 2026-03-31 notice instead.

CCF counts only Full/Regular papers. Its notice explicitly excludes Short, Demo, Technical Brief, Summary, Findings and Workshop papers, so ACL Findings or NeurIPS workshop papers do not count as CCF-A.

Tsinghua TH-CPL, per the community ccf-deadlines dataset (not the official Tsinghua document; verify locally): ICLR A, RSS A, ICRA A, ECCV A, EMNLP A; CVPR/ICCV/NeurIPS/ICML/AAAI/ACL/ACM MM A; IJCAI B, IROS B, AAMAS B; CoRL not listed.

Prestigious robotics venues (CoRL, RSS, T-RO, IJRR, RA-L, Science Robotics) earn little or no CCF-A credit. Many schools publish their own recognized-venue lists (认定目录). Whether yours counts RSS/CoRL or TH-CPL-A as A is unverified; check the graduate-school list first.

Realistic CCF-A timeline after 2026-10-19: CVPR 2027 (Nov 16, 2026), then ACL 2027 ARR (Jan 4, 2027), ICML 2027 (~late Jan, est.), ICCV 2027 (~early Mar, est.), ACM MM 2027 (~early Apr, est.), NeurIPS 2027 (~early May, est.), AAAI-28 (~late Jul, est.), ICLR 2028 (~late Sep, est.).

Resubmission chain: CVPR 2027 decisions (Feb 25, 2027) arrive before the expected ICCV 2027 deadline (~Mar). CVPR 2027 bars substantially similar submissions elsewhere during its review period (Nov 16, 2026 to Feb 22, 2027) and treats work online after Sep 15, 2026 as contemporaneous.

Dual submission and preprints: CVPR treats arXiv as non-publication and counts 20% or more overlap as a dual submission. Workshop papers over 4 pages (excl. references) count as prior publication, so use 4-page or non-archival workshops. ICLR 2027 allows arXiv during review but bans parallel review.

Page limits (verified): CVPR 8 pages excluding references (CVPR 2026 guidelines); ICLR 2027 9 pages at submission, 10 at rebuttal/camera-ready, appendix unlimited (reviewers need not read it). AAAI, NeurIPS, ICML and ACL limits not verified this pass; check each CFP or author kit.

Supplementary video: CVPR accepts videos inside the anonymized supplementary upload but forbids links to external videos or sites and any author identity in demo videos; rebuttals cannot link external material. Anonymize real-robot demo videos (lab logos, faces, robot branding).

Quotas and obligations: CVPR 2026 capped submissions at 25 per author; at CVPR 2027 every author must review if invited. ICLR 2027 caps authors at 20 papers, and authors with no eligible reciprocal reviewer get only one paper, which matters for a first-time student team.

Quadruped and real-robot work does land at CCF-A venues: CE-Nav and NavFoM (ICLR 2026, real quadruped deployment), OneOcc (CVPR 2026, QuadOcc benchmark), ODYSSEY (AAAI-26). Efficiency papers suit an 8 GB GPU: EfficientNav and DynaNav (NeurIPS 2025), VLA-Adapter (AAAI-26, single consumer GPU).

Acceptance rates for CVPR 2026, ICCV 2025, ICLR 2026 and ICML 2025 come from Paper Copilot (community aggregator); CVPR/NeurIPS/AAAI 2025 rates come from github.com/lixin4ever/Conference-Acceptance-Rate. These are not official program-chair numbers.

Research limits: the WebSearch budget ran out partway through, so later facts came from direct fetches of official pages. dblp, ACM DL and OpenReview blocked automated access, so ACM MM and 2025-26 journal example papers are unverified. Community ccf-deadlines data is used only where it matches official pages or is flagged as community data.

Non-A options with nearby deadlines: AAMAS 2027 (B) passed Oct 8, 2026; IJCAI-27 (now B) Jan 4/11, 2027; EMNLP 2027 (B) via ARR, ~May 2027 est.; ECCV 2028 (B) ~Mar 2028 est.; RSS 2027 (not CCF) extended abstract Dec 4, 2026.
